scan_directory_for_files: scan a directory recursively for files matching a suffix and return relative paths
open_file_flexible: open a file using either a string path or pathlib.Path object with standard open arguments
create_directory_safe: create a directory or verify it already exists with a specified permission mode
find_vcs_root: find the root directory of a git repository by walking up from a given path
check_file_exists: check if a file exists at a given path and raise FileNotFoundError if missing
